description: This file defines the DimEntry class and related functions for handling tensor dimension levels, including comparison, identification of positional and None states, and tensor reshaping using as_strided.

classes.name: DimEntry
classes.description: Represents a tensor dimension, either as a Dim object or an integer, with methods for comparison and identification of positional or None states.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a DimEntry with a Dim object, an integer (must be negative), or None (defaults to 0).

methods.name: __eq__
methods.description: Checks equality between two DimEntry objects, considering positional and Dim object cases.

methods.name: is_positional
methods.description: Returns True if the data is a negative integer, indicating a positional dimension.

methods.name: is_none
methods.description: Returns True if the data represents a 'none' state (i.e., zero).

methods.name: position
methods.description: Returns the integer value if data is an int.

methods.name: dim
methods.description: Returns the Dim object if data is a Dim.

methods.name: repr
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the data.
